key_insight: NeuMesh++ represents 3D scenes with a mesh-based neural field that separates geometry, texture, and semantic information, making volumetric editing more flexible and efficient. This disentangled design enables richer edits than rigid transforms or category-specific methods.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the limited editing capabilities of current neural rendering methods, which often only support rigid transformations or narrow, category-specific edits and struggle to provide versatile, efficient volumetric manipulation.
method: Encode a neural radiance field on mesh vertices instead of relying only on a dense implicit volume.
Disentangle scene information into separate geometry, texture, and semantic codes for more controllable editing.
Use the mesh-based representation to support versatile volumetric editing with improved efficiency.
Leverage the disentangled codes to enable more fine-grained and general-purpose scene modifications.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, NeuMesh++ offers a more practical way to edit 3D scenes with stronger control and better efficiency. It can simplify workflows in AR/VR, content creation, and scene manipulation where precise and flexible edits are important.

paper_title: NeuMesh++: Towards Versatile and Efficient Volumetric Editing with Disentangled Neural Mesh-based Implicit Field
paper_authors: Chong Bao, Yuan Li, Bangbang Yang, Yujun Shen, Hujun Bao
